**Finding: Deviation (high) — § 14.2 Deliverable licence**

The main grant clauses are already playbook-compliant:
- **§ 13.1** — Services licence expressly covers Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf.
- **§ 13.2** — Paid-up software/Vendor Technology licence is perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, covers Affiliates and permits contractor support.
- **§ 13.3** — Transfer to an Affiliate or successor permitted; revocation/suspension only for material uncured breach after notice and cure.

**§ 14.2 is the outlier.** It grants only a "revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term" — i.e. revocable at Vendor's discretion, no Affiliate/contractor coverage, no successor transfer, and expiry on term end even though Deliverables (reports, configurations, integrations, workflows, training material) are created specifically for us and outlive the order.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — § 14.2 rewritten to give Customer, its Affiliates and contractors a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify and create derivative works from each Deliverable, transferable and revocable only per § 13.3. Vendor's ownership of Deliverables is left untouched, keeping the edit minimal and consistent with the bargain already struck in § 13.
